messages:
Maya: FYI I'm flagging the Acme trial — onboarding stalled after they tried to integrate. Low calls, customer seeing 401 on every request.
Alex: can you paste the exact error they send? 401 usually key or header issue.
Maya: customer logs: `{"error":"Unauthorized","code":401}`. They used the example env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY=__` from the guide.
Sam: renewal risk? are they on a paid trial or free?
Maya: monthly trial (stage: eval). Usage from last 7 days: 0 calls. They hit the first integration step and stopped.
Jordan: 401 -> likely bad key/headers or org mismatch. We should give them a small validation curl they can run. I can add a scoped TTL token if we want to avoid sharing prod creds.
Alex: I'll draft a one-pager troubleshooting snippet + a tiny sample app link. Helps reduce back-and-forth.
Maya: proposed quick plan: 1) 30-min diag call (CSM+AE+eng) 2) hand them the one-pager + sample app 3) create a temp read-only token we control 4) 7-day enablement sprint, then re-evaluate. If no progress, offer soft off-ramp (grace period + onboarding credit).
Sam: that sounds good. Do we have precedent for soft off-ramp terms? I can offer a 20% onboarding credit and keep them on trial for 14 more days.
Jordan: ETA: I can spin up a TTL token and a validator endpoint in a small PR. Snippet I'll add to the one-pager:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
     https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/health
```
If that returns 200 we're good. If 401 we return details.
Alex: linking to PR draft: https://git.redwood/eng/snippets/quick-validator (WIP)
ops-bot: reminder set "at-risk" tag on account `acme-inc` in CRM and create a follow-up task for 7 days.
Maya: I'll schedule the diag call for tomorrow 10am PST and drop calendar invites. Alex, Jordan - can you both join?
Alex: yes, will prep the one-pager in the next hour.
Jordan: joining. PR in 1.5h, will post link here.
Sam: I'll update the renewal score and note soft-offramp option.
Maya: closing loop — goal is to get a successful `health` call in the session. If green, convert to onboarding play. If no progress after the sprint, we present the off-ramp + credit. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: single slack thread representing a churn-prevention coordination convo; short, practical messages; no title field per agents.md
